evidence.quote: English is the language of instruction.
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,000 EUR

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page states a tuition fee of 1,000 EUR per semester for non-EU applicants for this programme. The university's central tuition page confirms 1000 euros per semester for non-EEA students enrolling as of winter semester 2026/27, and the programme is specifically listed as one subject to tuition (B-MEC: Mechanical Engineering (B.Eng.), international). The fee is per semester, not per year. Intakes: only the winter semester application period (2 May - 15 July) is stated with day and month but no year, so no exact deadline date was extracted; the summer intake is stated as only for transfer students with advanced standing. Application channel: no page states that applicants must apply via uni-assist or that a VPD is needed; the DAAD page says 'Submit application via Please check this website.' so applicationChannel was left out.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: IELTS Academic: 6 TOEFL iBT (since 2026): 4.5 TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 80 PTE Academic: 65 TOEIC: 850
German language skills A1 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: telc Deutsch: telc Deutsch A1 ÖSD Zertifikat: A1 Goethe-Zertifikat: Goethe-Zertifikat A1

note.fr: Vérifiez les critères d'admission académique (HZB, reconnaissance des diplômes, lettre de motivation, CV, SAT/TestAS avec score spécifique) sur le site du programme.
note.en: Check the academic admission requirements (HZB, recognition of certificates, motivation letter, CV, SAT/TestAS with specific score) on the programme website.

evidence.quote: Additionally, for applicants from outside of the European Economic Area (EEA) and without a German higher education entrance qualification: Motivation letter in the English language Curriculum vitae in tabulated format, written in the English language Scholastic aptitude test: SAT or TestAS (Core Test and Engineering Module) with a specific score.
